description:
Send an SMS, iMessage, or WhatsApp message from one of your agent's phone numbers, or react to an existing message.
Each message is individually authorized by the user: this returns a preview and sends nothing unless confirm=true, so confirm the recipient(s) and content with the user before sending.
The tool has two modes, so which inputs are required depends on the mode:
- Send: give a destination and a sender (agent_id, from_number, or number_id), plus body and/or media. The destination is either to_number (a single recipient or existing group) or recipients (members of a NEW iMessage group) — exactly one. The agent must have a phone number attached; number_id or from_number picks which one when it has several.
- React: set reaction and react_to_message_id (iMessage only) to tapback or emoji-react to a message. Pass no send fields; those are rejected.
Channel: omit channel to auto-pick SMS/iMessage; set channel=whatsapp to force WhatsApp, which also unlocks the interactive fields (buttons, list, cta, template — one per message, and a template is needed to start a new WhatsApp conversation).
iMessage extras (ignored on SMS): reply_to_message_id threads a reply, and send_style adds an expressive effect.
Returns the sent message (id, status, channel, from/to numbers), or the applied reaction.

agent_id.description: The agent ID to send a message from (must have a phone number attached). Optional with from_number or number_id; omit for reactions.

body.description: The message text to send (may be empty when sending media only)

buttons.description: WhatsApp only (channel=whatsapp). Up to a few quick-reply button labels shown under the message. Mutually exclusive with list, cta, and template.

channel.description: Force delivery over WhatsApp. Omit to let the server pick SMS/iMessage automatically. Required to use the WhatsApp interactive fields (buttons, list, cta, template).

confirm.description: Must be true to actually place the call / send the message. When false (the default), the tool returns a preview and does nothing — every outbound call and message is individually authorized by the user. Get the user's explicit go-ahead, then call again with the same arguments plus confirm=true.

cta.description: WhatsApp only (channel=whatsapp). A call-to-action (e.g. URL button) object. Mutually exclusive with buttons, list, and template.

from_number.description: Exact number to send a message from in E.164 format (alternative to number_id). Omit for reactions.

list.description: WhatsApp only (channel=whatsapp). An interactive list message object. Mutually exclusive with buttons, cta, and template.

media_url.description: Link (URL) to a single image or media file to attach to the message.

media_urls.description: Multiple media links (URLs) to attach, delivered as an image carousel on iMessage.

number_id.description: ID of the specific number to send from (from list_numbers). Use when the agent has more than one number; omit for reactions.

react_to_message_id.description: iMessage only. ID of a message to react to. Set together with `reaction`.

reaction.description: iMessage only. Tapback or single emoji applied to react_to_message_id: one of love, like, dislike, laugh, emphasize, question, or a single emoji (e.g. '🔥'). When set, this reacts instead of sending a message.

recipients.description: Create a NEW iMessage group and send to these members (phone numbers in any format, or other identifiers). Use instead of to_number. The server normalizes and de-duplicates them and requires 2–32 distinct members. Cannot be combined with channel=whatsapp.

reply_to_message_id.description: iMessage only. ID of an earlier message to reply to inline (threaded reply)

send_style.description: An expressive screen or bubble effect played when the message arrives (iMessage only; ignored on SMS).

template.description: WhatsApp only (channel=whatsapp). A pre-approved template message object, required to open a new WhatsApp conversation outside the 24h customer-service window. Mutually exclusive with buttons, list, and cta.

to_number.description: Recipient: a phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +14155551234), a US short code, or a group ID (grp_...) to post into an EXISTING iMessage group chat. Give either to_number or recipients, not both. Not needed for a reaction.

name: send_message

outputSchema.description: The sent message, the applied reaction, or a confirmation-required preview when confirm was not set.

channel.description: Channel used: sms or imessage, or null.

confirmationRequired.description: True when the message was only previewed (confirm was not true); re-call with confirm=true to send it.

from_number.description: Number the message was sent from.

id.description: The sent message's ID (or the reaction's ID); absent on a confirmation preview.

message_id.description: Message the reaction was applied to (reaction mode only).

reply_parent_unresolved.description: True if the reply parent could not be threaded.

reply_to_message_id.description: Message this was threaded under, or null.

title: Send Message
